isolation.omissionReason: Avoid installed-payload mutation, cleanup and remote companion fetch; disclose omitted cost versus installed baseline.

stages.name: composition
stages.includes: workspace discovery/config, Git detection, registration, preliminary theme-cache read
stages.additivity: Contains nested preliminary store work; lazy leaf service resolution may fall outside.

stages.name: store-open-total
stages.includes: native operation gate, mirror admission, store constructor
stages.additivity: Nested inside composition or service resolution; identify every store instance.

stages.name: store-initialize
stages.includes: connection open, collation, WAL, durable attach/version checks, schemas, generation stamp
stages.additivity: Subset of store-open-total, never sum both.

stages.name: initial-admission
stages.includes: bound runtime operation lease, repository operation lease, binding expected-origin check, cached Bench existence and exact capture

stages.name: data-reads
stages.includes: item, definitions, status entries, children, parent, links, pending changes

stages.name: layout-and-native-serialization
stages.includes: full Show projection, process child progress, safe HTML, wrapping, native ANSI output

stages.name: final-admission
stages.includes: mutable binding/identity/Operation comparison and captured current Bench recheck

reuseExperiment.mechanism: Invoke the same real BenchDetailCommand instance repeatedly after DI resolution; retain its unchanged inner native operation code and fresh admission/repository using scopes per invocation.
reuseExperiment.idle: Between-call delay after ExecuteAsync returns and leases are disposed; no permanent idle lease.
reuseExperiment.failure: Stop on nonzero/cancellation/binding-generation refusal, do not reconnect, change identity, retarget or retry.

measurementRows.processFirst: First cached detail in new native process; OS cache uncontrolled, not OS-cold.
measurementRows.warmOneShot: Subsequent separate native launches after successful same-context cached read.
measurementRows.warmReused: Subsequent commands on same DI/store after first invocation, with operation-scoped authority.
measurementRows.nativeWall: Process create through exit plus captured streams.
measurementRows.bracketedWall: Native connection status before, cached detail, native connection status after, JSON decode and origin comparison; not input-to-painted-frame.
dimensions: available native HTML field character sizes
measurementRows.persist: Timing, dimensions, sample count, width, runtime/SDK/RID, exit outcome, stage nesting only; no credential/work-item content in result artifacts.
measurementRows.minimumSamples: Propose at least 20 warm samples per item/width/mode; owner approves latency targets separately.
